project.name: Voice Consistency Test
project.description: Two short Seedance clips testing whether reference_audios holds character voice

source.prompt: Anime-style hand-drawn animation. Maya, the sharp female news anchor, sits at the news desk and looks at camera with a small dry smirk. She delivers in her polished anchor voice, exactly: 'And in tonight's lead story: yet another scandal.' One subtle eyebrow raise on 'scandal'. Camera locked off, no movement. Audio: clean close-mic'd dialogue matching the reference voice timbre, faint studio room tone.

Anime-style hand-drawn animation. Trip, the blonde himbo co-host, grins wide-eyed at camera and exclaims sincerely in his upbeat doofus voice, exactly: 'Oh boy, scandals are my favorite!' He gives a cheerful little fist-pump on 'favorite'. Camera locked off. Audio: clean close-mic'd dialogue matching the reference voice timbre, faint studio room tone.
